methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: The Ethics of Intelligence: Hampton University Builds an AI Ecosystem for a Future Where Access, Data, Opportunity Matter - Morningstar
signals.signal_reading: Hampton University's AI ecosystem initiative represents intentional capability-building in a region outside the NoVA hub, focusing on equitable access and ethics—signaling distributed development if it successfully transfers deep knowledge beyond metro centers.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: A Norfolk native delivering free AI workshops directly addresses the distribution challenge through grassroots peer learning networks, attempting to build depth in Hampton Roads rather than relying on platform-mediated shallow adoption.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - news.vcu.edu
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA concentrates educational resources and innovation infrastructure in the state capital metro, potentially deepening Richmond's capability while the distribution mechanism to smaller regions remains unclear.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: AI pressure on Richmond's young workforce without corresponding deep training infrastructure suggests employers demanding AI competencies faster than educational systems can develop them, risking shallow adoption or displacement rather than capability building.

signals.title: Norfolk could get AI assist for non-emergency calls - Yahoo
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk's consideration of AI-assisted dispatch for non-emergency calls represents platform-delivered automation that creates operational efficiency without building deep local AI capability—classic shallow distributed adoption through vendor solutions.
